scope.frame: frame C's own channels (B1945's split) in B1736's closed form, with any constant Higgs triplet h in C^3; the charge rule
scope.object: the least heavy-pair ratio compatible with an aligned mixing (smallest diagonal 0.9), and counterexamples with three distinct masses, on 2,016 points
scope.hypotheses: an adversarial Nelder-Mead search (8 starts of 2,000 evaluations per point), not exhaustive; orders 5 and 7, four columns, heights 1 to 10; double precision, the closed form checked to 1e-16 against the frame

claim_one_line: ON A GRID OF 2,016 POINTS FRAME C'S OWN CHANNELS NEVER REACH THE TUNED REGION (OPEN, a search; data-free; P-879): with any Higgs triplet in C^3 an adversary finds no aligned charge-consistent mixing with a heavy-pair hierarchy and three distinct masses at any point (orders 5 and 7, four columns, heights 1 to 10); alignment 0.9 is reachable at 52 to 64 of 72 points per row but only with the least heavy-pair ratio 0.457 to 0.476, the search always ending at the real-Higgs end; no single channel invariant is constant, so the floor comes from the pairing of the up and down channels, which frame C's charges never tune as B1967's escape needs; a proof is P-879. 0 of 19.
